objective: Avoid materializing and chunk-copying an unchanged GEODATA coordinate-system definition while preserving existing newline normalization and text policies.

behavior: GEODATA uses a view of the source coordinate-system definition when no LF normalization is needed.
A temporary normalized string is created only when LF must be replaced with the existing caret-J spelling.
The internal UTF-8 writer accepts string_view, and 255-byte GEODATA continuation slices are passed synchronously without substring allocations.
Strict-lossless encoding, legacy codepage conversion, record-safety rejection, and wire chunk order remain unchanged.
implementation.compatibility: Internal writer implementation only; no installed API, public class layout, or DRW_Interface callback changed.

controls: Generated AC1021/AC1032 ASCII/Binary GEODATA v2 controls assert exact 255/255/10 group-303/group-301 chunks and a following-record sentinel.
Both compatible and strict-lossless policies are covered; LF input confirms the existing caret-J normalization and source immutability.
limits: Copy avoidance is established by the source path and exact generated wire controls; allocator counts, peak RSS, and throughput were not measured.
Legacy codepage conversion and strict-lossless encoded storage remain materialized by design.
No full suite, peer runtime, native CAD application, external drawing, or sanitizer/fuzz campaign was run.
